title: What Do British People Complain About Most
paragraphs: British people are famous for complaining. But what do they complain about the most? A new survey has the answer.
The survey was done by the polling company YouGov for Liberty, a human rights group in the UK. More than 2,000 people took part. The results were shared in October 2026.

The most popular thing to complain about was current affairs, or the news. About 24% of people chose this. In second place was rude people, at 18%, followed by work at 11%. Other popular topics were traffic at 8% and the weather at 6%.

The survey also asked which behaviors in public annoy people most. The top answer was people being rude to shop and restaurant workers. This annoys 67% of people. Next was people who jump the queue, which annoys 59%. About half of people said they do not like it when others talk on their phone using the speaker.
People also named the sounds they dislike most. The top answer was people eating loudly, followed by drunk people shouting or singing, and loud car or motorbike engines.

Most British people agree that they like to complain. About 76% said they are complainers, while 20% said they never complain. However, most people do not complain to the person who caused the problem. Instead, 45% said they usually complain to a partner or family member.
Liberty did the survey to start a campaign about free speech. Akiko Hart, the director of Liberty, said that the freedom to speak up and disagree is an important British value.
